item.description: Archaeologists exploring Bure in northeastern France uncovered 28 ancient Gallic coins alongside human skull fragments. The site is believed to be a Late Iron Age sanctuary used by the Leuci. In addition to the coins, a miniature bronze wagon wheel was also found, suggesting ritual significance. The discovery contributes to understanding the cultural and religious practices of ancient Gaul. Ongoing studies aim to clarify the site's history and purpose. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
